intent.goal: Demonstrate a managed map-reduce pattern for independent documentation audit items.
acceptance_criteria: The graph validates against the current v1 contract.
The managed node discovers, freezes, maps, and reduces independent item evidence.
A downstream deterministic check verifies the stable aggregate artifact.
constraints: Do not depend on dynamic item refs.

intent.goal: Audit selected product documentation files for stale managed-pattern terminology.
acceptance_criteria: Every selected documentation item is inspected or recorded with concrete skip/blocker evidence.
The aggregate artifact separates passed, finding, skipped, and blocked items with source evidence.
The coverage summary explains selected files, omissions, and residual uncertainty.

context.name: product_docs
context.what: Product documentation files that describe Agentflow workflow and managed-pattern behavior.
context.why: The item planner needs a bounded documentation set to select independent audit items.

intent.goal: Find product documentation files that should be audited for stale managed-pattern terminology.
acceptance_criteria: Each item has a stable id, input, title, and scope rationale.
The item list records omitted candidates and uncertainty when relevant.
constraints: Do not include generated files or dependency directories.

intent.goal: Inspect one frozen documentation item for stale managed-pattern terminology.
acceptance_criteria: The item result records passed, finding, skipped, or blocked status.
The item result cites exact source evidence.
Findings include the stale term, rationale, and source evidence.
constraints: Do not inspect unrelated files except linked docs needed to judge this item.

intent.goal: Publish a verified aggregate documentation terminology audit.
acceptance_criteria: Every frozen item has one terminal accepted result.
The aggregate groups findings, passes, skipped items, blockers, and uncertainty.
The aggregate is sufficient for downstream review without reading item directories first.
constraints: Do not claim full documentation coverage beyond the frozen item set and recorded discovery evidence.

args: const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const input=process.env.AGENTFLOW_CONTEXT_AGGREGATE; const outputDir=process.env.AGENTFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR; const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(input,'utf8')); const counts=data.counts||{}; const items=Array.isArray(data.items)?data.items:[]; const total=Object.values(counts).reduce((sum,value)=>sum+value,0); const passed=data.status==='completed' && items.length>0 && total===items.length && items.every((item,index)=>item && item.id===`m${index+1}` && typeof item.summary==='string' && item.summary.trim().length>0); const result={passed,status:data.status,item_count:items.length,counts}; if (outputDir) { fs.mkdirSync(outputDir,{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outputDir,'verification.json'), JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+'\n'); } console.log(JSON.stringify(result)); process.exit(passed?0:1);

intent.goal: Verify the managed map-reduce node published a stable completed aggregate artifact.
acceptance_criteria: The aggregate includes at least one sequential item with a summary.
The status counts equal the item count.

context.name: aggregate
context.what: Stable aggregate evidence from the managed map-reduce node.
context.why: The deterministic check verifies the aggregate item coverage contract is present and suitable for later review.

verification.description: Structured result for the aggregate artifact verification.
